title: Viva Insights: new Overview page in the Agent Dashboard
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, licence prerequisites, default state and automation are supported. Minor corrections should complete the web-app policy route, acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting role guidance and narrow the cost rationale; the access-review checklist also refers to a control missing from the table.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn still marks the Copilot Agent Dashboard view as public preview, unlike the roadmap's Launched status.
claims.quote: The Copilot Agent Dashboard view within the Agent Dashboard is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard is on by default for people with access, without administrator action.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard is on by default as part of the Viva Insights web app. Use the steps below to change this setting.

claims.claim: Licensing is mixed across the two views: Microsoft Copilot prerequisites, with Agent 365 licensing additionally required for the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: Copilot Agent Dashboard: Your organization must have at least 50 Microsoft Copilot licenses assigned and have agent activity. Agent 365 Dashboard: The same licensing requirements as the Copilot Agent Dashboard view, plus Agent 365 licensing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard Learn page publishes no separate Overview-page price, meter or charge.
claims.quote: Searched: Agent Dashboard Overview page Viva Insights price meter separate charge licensing. Read agent-dashboard in full and manage-settings-copilot-dashboard; results name view prerequisites and reported Copilot Credits, not an Overview-page price or meter.
claims.fix: In the cost rationale replace 'and no separate charge for the Overview page' with 'and publishes no separate price or meter for the Overview page', preserving the distinction between an unpublished charge and a documented absence of charges.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard policy is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : AgentDashboard
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: AI Administrators and Global Administrators can manage the Agent Dashboard control.
claims.quote:
In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.
Enable or disable the Agent Dashboard
Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard control can enable or disable access at tenant, group or user level.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level using the Agent Dashboard VFAM control in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The Viva Insights web-app policy is reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu. Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy.
claims.fix: Complete the path as 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Insights > Viva Insights web app > Access setting > Off'. The cited page next requires choosing the app and feature and the Access setting; the row's existing note identifies the app and feature.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide web-app disabling policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.quote:
Enable or disable the Viva Insights web app

claims.fix: Add to the existing role sentence: 'The feature-access-management table instead lists Global admin for the Viva Insights web app control.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/feature-access-management, already in sources. Report the disagreement rather than replacing the cited feature-specific role.

claims.claim: Access to the Agent Dashboard requires both the web-app control and the Agent Dashboard control to be enabled.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: Viva feature access policies take effect within 24 hours unless otherwise noted.

claims.claim: Users with access find the dashboard by selecting Agent Dashboard in the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: If you have access to the Agent Dashboard, you can find it in the Viva Insights web app. On the left, select Agent Dashboard.

claims.quote: The overview page includes: Top-level insights into agent and user adoption over the last 28 days. Agent creation insights that break down active agents by creator type.
